review_text: Title says it all. Big selection of combo lunches for less than $5.00 including canned soft drink. The place is clean and has seating for eat-in. In a store front at Old Fox Hill Rd and King St. Golden City Chinese Restaurant is a good place to quickly pickup some Chinese food. They have reasonably priced combination meals that include your entre, fried rice, and an egg roll.

Okay I totally love my regular place, but decided to check this one out. First off it took 2 hours for it to be delivered, no biggie I think if the food is amazing. Unfortunately that isnt the case. I got chicken lo mein...could barely find chicken, was dry. General Tso wasnt good at all and the fried rice  and white rice was like rocks...I dont like wasting food but I tried to eat it...very disappointed, threw it all away. I will definitely be sticking to my regular place.

Last night the food was delivered to my Hotel room with no problem...This afternoon, I place a order. I was informed the delivery may be an hour late...Well, one hour and fifteen minutes later, I recieved a call ..Meet them in the lobby. What?? I wasn't prepared for that. Just last night the driver came to my room..What changed over night?
It has a friendly staff and real reasonable prices!!!
DO NOT ORDER FOR DELIVERY. They do not bring you your order and try to tell you that what they brought you is what you ordered… 🤬🤬🤬
Nice place for a piece of pizza. Love their wings too!

Everyone is very friendly and the pizza was delivered hot. My only problem is the sauce was to sweet. As soon as I took a bite I tasted sugar. This did not taste  like the papa John's that I've enjoyed all these years. I'm disappointed in the new recipe.
We order every week for our team lunches and dinners. Always got and fresh and quick delivery.. thank you for the consistency we love!

Google says it’s open till midnight, but it’s wrong. At 10:30 it was closed for customers even if there were employees inside. The employee said its only available for orders by phone, and they don’t do delivery to the parking lot. This is ridiculous way to lose customers and money.
Whenever I get drinks with my order they always forget them.

This restaurant is certainly one of the most attractive place to eat in the region. Every time I come to this place I am deeply glad. They preserve their high  standard service and the topmost level of food  they provide. You are always happy with this place. Warmly  recommended.
Loved the food. A little short on staff when we went which caused some issues, but really tried to make things work the best they could
Absolutely delicious. You'll probably have to wait for your food, but it is 100% worth the wait. I was too full for dessert, but I couldn't resist some fresh mango and sticky rice!
The atmosphere is beautiful. The staff is friendly. The food is epic!
Small friendly and tasty - try try the deck on a summer night.

-  food was really good even gave you plastic ware for takeout orders

- service was quick

- food was fresh and real good quality

- prices were not bad at all for the area

- you get a good amount of food too

- a little messy on the inside with clutter, not a deal breaker

- overall a good first experience

I had Maggios pizza and thought it was good, until I saved some for the next day. The only analogy I think of is finding a $20 bill in your pocket when you thought you just spent your last dollar. The pizza is great!

I've ordered from Maggiano's in the past and the experience was quite good. However today's order was really really bad, the gyro meat was old, dry, and  overcooked to a crisp resembling jerky. The normally great Greek salad was not as fresh either.
Great food and service.

The place have win, beer and liquor. Not only the drink was good, but the price was reasonable. I loved the setup of the new bar and the atmosphere.  The owner David is very nice man with his staff and that is a plus.
Wow!  We didn't have college food like that back in the day!  Delicious options for those with food allergies.
My savior during undergrad. I’d love to come here during all-nighters for a break and some food to fuel up. Good eats, good memories. Will always be grateful to Southside xx

All you can eat buffet usually crowded at night. Dish conveyor belt for your plates and cups. COVID strict rules. Usually has everything a person needs for all meals of the day. However, sometimes the food is stale or has little to no flavor.

all u can eat.  went once pretty decent! ice cream was slightly hard to get during peak lunch time.  was pretty busy and backed up dish washing.  special employees and composting practices{as well as 10 dollar price} make relatively green and compelling.. wish people would still waste as little as possible!

The dining hall is good because it serves a variety of food every day, but if you do not like the meals that change daily, then you have to eat what is there every day.  This can get old after a while.  During busy hours, it is hard to find a seat, but during times when there are few students, it is a nice environment to enjoy a meal.
Delicious food.   A bit hard to get over being in a mini mall but worth a try.
Great idea in theory, but still lots of issues in execution. I got a roots and mushroom bowl, but none of the grains were cooked (not dry, they weren't cooked!).

I knew B. Good when they were just starting out in Boston. They've grown a bit and feel more like a nicer fast-casual chain now in some ways, but we were very pleased with our recent visit where we ate mostly off the seasonal summer menu. The BBQ chicken bowl was nourishing and refreshing, the Mac side was super yummy, and the strawberry basil blended ice was delicious without being overly sweet. The restaurant was clean and the service was excellent. We don't mind waiting a few more minutes for our food, it's worth it.

I visited for lunch today .The people who work here are amazing! Each one was so sweet and helpful. The butternut squash soup was too spicy for me, but they let me exchange it for sweet potato fries. I watched them bend over backward to help other customers. It made being there a joy!
The eggplant meat balls and the #2 sandwich with chicken was great! Some people with me had trouble with the menu, however, they loved the 37 foot ceiling, lol.
Great service and design. Cauliflower was amazing and Pork sandwich was solid as well. Drinks were a little on the light side but overall great experience. Great outdoor patio to people watch.

Visited Little Star for the first time and it was pure magic. Our server was friendly and all around incredible. The interior was gorgeous and they made excellent use of the space. The flatware was beautiful and every piece was a little bit different. Cocktails were delicious and very inventive. The food was out of this world delicious and the pacing of each dish brought out was perfect. Some have complained in reviews of being a bit pricey but I feel it's appropriately priced for the quality and service.

Such an amazing dining experience in Charlottesville! Beth, our server, made our time so comfortable - all of the staff are attentive, friendly, offer great recommendations. The food came out quickly and was great - awesome flavors and so unique! We can’t wait to come back and try more dishes! There was nothing we didn’t like!

We had reservations for my husbands birthday and arrived a little early and were told we would be seated in a couple of minutes. 25 minutes later, when I asked the hosted how much longer it would be, she rudely responded that it "takes 2 plus hours for our diners to eat". I totally get that, but they shouldn't be booking reservations so close together if that's the case. (We were among many others waiting quite a bit of time)

Thankfully, our waitress, Beth, Joel, and all the food were amazing and redeemed the rest of the night! Beth went above and beyond with her service, and made some wonderful suggestions. She even brought Joel over to speak to us about the tequilas they use and make drinks suggestions - all amazing! We enjoyed the food so much, I highly recommend the calamari and the pork spare ribs! If they iron out the reservations and the way they respond to long waits, they will go very far!
Excellent service, nice atmosphere and most important, "fantastic food" The beef rib dish and seared tuna are out of this world. Highly Recommend!

This place was lovely! A small place with great food. Not too crowded and staff was very friendly. Food was quick as well. They surprised us with a complimentary dessert which we appreciated! Thanks for the great meal!

Excellent food, hit the spot for Vietnamese craving.  Restaurant has a nice ambiance, feels nicer than your typical plaza stop.  The bun was warm, which was nice, in my limited experience, I feel like the noodles are often served room temp or even a little cold.   The bubble tea is really sweet (too sweet and syrupy for my taste but my kids were the ones enjoying it) and the shrimp chips and custard dessert are very lovely complimentary additions.

Fan-frickin-tastic! Why have I not been here before the past week?! I'll tell you why, because I've been a loyalist to Bale Family Bakery and Pho Sate in Falls Church. I just always went with what I knew, and never looked back.

What a disservice I did to myself. To have this gem, less that half a mile from the house is a game changer.

Very easy and relatable menu, nothing too crazy, but a great variety and good for those looking to delve in Vietnamese cuisine, without going overboard.

Pho is solid. Fantastic broth. Limited choice of selections, yet still ticks all the boxes.

Great shaky beef.great spring and summer rolls.

Dumplings are awesome, super filling and thin skinned.

Shrimp toast is awesome.

The grilled pork is worth the price of admission alone.

Looking forward to workingt5througj more of the menu, especially the bun bo hue.

The shrimp crackers and complimentary creme caramel/flan are a really nice touch.

Service is good, not hovering, yet attentive.

Reasonably priced.

Do it if you haven't already. You won't regret it. Support you local!
I love this place. I could eat here every day. I love pho, the garden rolls, Thai tea and the flan is delicious.

Came here for dinner on a Monday. Couldn’t tell if the place was open from the outside, lighting was very dim. Parking is always interesting in that area. Staff were very nice. Beautiful artwork/decor. Was offered shrimp chips to snack on. Everything tasted ok, food came out fairly quick. We order Pho Old Town/Pho Dac Biet, Spring rolls, Garden rolls and beef charbroiled over rice/ Com Thit Bo Nuong. Flan was offered at the end of our meal.

My husband and I love Indian food and if you feel the same way, you'll love this place! The staff was very friendly and the atmosphere was great. I had the Tikka Masala and it was perfect! With Indian food this good who cares about the parking?
First time eating Indian food and I enjoy the taste and flavors will be back again Buffet was reasonable too under 11 is a good price
Variety of delicious tastes !  Wait staff is VERY attentive and made sure we had everything we needed.  Music in the background was very soothing for lunchtime.
Amazing flavors and an array of choices to choose from at their buffet. Highly recommend!
Definitely one of the best restaurants in Roanoke. Delicious, fresh food and friendly staff.

Went for a FAMILY BREAKFAST! We had 10 members in our party we were seated in the banquet room close to the back. The service was great 2 wait staff served us. The food was delicious, hot, comfort, home style. The price was even better. I paid for 4 meals and it was less than 40 dollars. I still took food home because I was so full. My only complaint was the scrambled eggs next time I will ask to have them scrambled with sharp cheddar cheese. No other complaints and I will go back again and I recommend this resturant
Its a cash only restaurant that's worth a trip to the bank.  The service is outstanding and the food is quick and good.

My husband and I decided to try this restaurant after hearing rave reviews for years. I must say that we were not disappointed. The menu includes an extensive list of country breakfast items such as fried bologna and eggs, scrapple, corned beef hash and our favorite, fish and grits. They also offer lunch items at anytime if breakfast is not your thing. It’s a must try. But bring cash. They don’t accept cards.
Awesome place had breakfast with my queen love they service food was delicious

All the food was great a little greasy well very greasy my eggs shine like a Jerry curl and left the juice on the plate like the back of a cloth couch.  Even though the food will put me in a early grave I'll ne back I did not like the cash only and oh go and use my 2.75 atm fee out front to pay you 60$ meal for that you get a big middle finger this will be the last Time I eat here very upset that was left by a cook and the waitress put her bare hand in ice we drink out of and ate it yes they gave use new ice from front but I see this place may not be the place for me and my family sorry for the truth
Excellent food! Fast service, came here 2x in a week

Wow!!! Just wow! This place was really good. The wait wasn't too long, the servers were attentive, and the food was good. Very rarely do I have appetizers, an entre, and a dessert. I did this time an it was not a disappointment. The decor was amazing in this place. It really set the mood for dining. The food, drinks, and people in this establishment compliment each other. Great job Dok Khao Thai Eatery. I cant wait to see what experience the next visit brings! ลาก่อน for now!
Omg best Thai food ever!!!!!! Hands down I don't think I will be able to eat Thai food somewhere else 😆 great selection of food! Very impressed!!

Came in on a Sunday lunch with 4 other people and we're sat down immediately. It wasn't too busy but they had a good amount of people. Service was decent but the food took forever to come out. The food was overall good so no complaints there. Only thing that really got me was that their coffee was instant brewed.

The restaurant is so pretty from inside and “instagram” worthy.  The food is really good, I only wish that my drunken noodles were served hot as most Thai places.  They were warm but not a big deal.  Service was also great!
Would have been 5 star but that chicken sandwich is terrible. No mayonnaise or anything.  Everything else is great there.
This is why such an attitude this morning. Phone more important.  Not the usual workers today

Got order wrong. Ordered crispy chicken meal with sweet tea cut with unsweet tea. Tried to give me 2 large unsweet teas and said they had already charged me. Got cookies instead. They need to listen to the order. Why would I order 2 teas with my meal? Tea is too sweet unless cut but they got that wrong too. Maybe just a bad day. Usually pretty good.
A quick pick up to surprise my son at school with McDonald's at his request for his birthday! He loved it it was nice and hot & great customer service...
Good chicken tenders for $2.

Went here earlier today, for one item, went to self check out 10 items or less, the cashiers waiting to assist people were really into a conversation to the point that they behaved as if we were interrupting their day when we asked for help. There were about a dozen registers open with 4 customers,  but the people at the door coming in and going out acknowledged us.

My favorite find here are these Lacey’s dark chocolate crisps I cannot put them down. I have also found a ton of great deals such as you can find at Costco or Sams Club but this is close and convenient with IMO a lot more options than other places.
Rivals Costco and Sam's..... I enjoy the discounted membership fee.
Run, avoid this place unless you want poor customer service, excuses from management, and expired food.

No chinet thick plates. Urine all over bathroom floor. Toilet paper all over floor in stalls. Smelled terrible like urine. The smell was too strong. Couldn't use the bathroom just waited until I got home. Whole isle with no paper towels. I would think they would be on the ball. Tvs are also older so if one goes out good luck getting it fixed. A few I know experienced over 2 months to get their money back from asurion. This store used to be great. How it has fallen.

I love this place. The homemade jam, homemade ketchup, local coffee and overall local connection make this place a keeper. Excellent coffee which is hard to find in Reston. Avocado toast is amazing, great presentation, friendly staff, clean and simple bistro. Excellent prices!
Lovely little place for coffee and brunch.  I am enjoying a croquet madam.
One of the best cappuccinos I’ve had in NOVA! Coffee flavor came through strong and full bodied. Will be returning soon! :)

A bit understaffed if you are just dropping in for coffee to go. I was also disappointed that my cold brew was diluted with water to be a more regular ice coffee strength. Seems a nice place to chill though and the jazz duo playing when I was here was good
Cozy venue for live music. Friendly staff and good food. Nice homey venue for coffee and/or dinning with live music. Fills fast in evenings. Make reservations.
This is one of the best German pastry and sweets shop for the DC region. Parking is extremely limited. Weekends have a takeaway option for hot brats, wersts, potato salad, etc. And pretzels :)
Delicious little bakery! I used to live very near Heidelberg for several years and walking in here felt like I was back. The leberkase sandwich was delicious and the worker was very helpful!

Heidelberg Pastry Shoppe (& Deli) is the real-honest-to-goodness-deal. So many delicious cookies, cakes, tarts, pies, doughnuts, croissants, turnovers and other pastries as well as REAL bread - YES truly real bread - it's impossible to list them all.

Beautiful birthday cakes baked with love. Colorfully designed cookies. Pretzels both savory and sweet. Delicious German sausages and German delicatessen foods galore. Yes! They make sandwiches too!

Charming area to dine inside. Cute area outside with shade trees and tables topped with umbrellas.

There's also a small market with gourmet German foods, herbs and spices for bread dipping, birthday cards, candles, colorful paper napkins and plates.

While waiting to check out there were German folks in line ahead of me complimenting the staff on their cookies, cakes and sandwiches. Remarking that they "always come here" for the best European baked goods and authentic German-style sandwiches.

And the staff are so nice! Actual smiles and sincere thank yous.

This place is a true treasure. Please support this locally owned family business. You will not be disappointed.

Excellent brats and hot German potato salad outside. Delicious pastries inside...almond sweet pretzels, cherry strudel, lemon poppy pound cake, pretzels and more. Also Kuhne sweet Bavarian style mustard and traditional German mustard! Shopped inside first and then bought our grilled lunch to go! ♡♡♡

Loved this place. Everything is baked fresh and in house. Prices are reasonable and they have a wide variety. My friends German and she said this is as authentic as it gets. I tried the bread and pretzel and they were both delicious

Love the ambience- quiet and calm. Good spot for romantic dining. The menu is little confusing. We had 4-5 chicken and pork dishes and everything was good. Their persimmon juice was  good too.  I don’t know the names of the dishes they put there. Over all I recommend this place. Our waitress was wonderful 🙂.

Great food, great service! The flavors were so amazing, I knew there must be real Brazilians in the kitchen. I was right! This husband wife team are the owners and the wife came to our table to personally welcome us. Nice experience.
The croc pot definitely hit the spot - it's light and tasty too! Also their Forte dipping sauce is fantastic. Apart from that, the service and ambience of the place was very good.
Good choice for meat lover. Just try

Highly recommend to check out their online menu before going if you are not familiar with Brazilian food, as the on-line version presents you pictures for better visualization (but be aware that discrepancy may exist. For example, my corcovado did not contain green leaves but the online menu has). Located just around the corner of a Starbucks. Food taste good in general but is a little pricey compared to the portion. Also, not sure if Brazillian style is pretty close to American style, I didn't feel strongly any unique Brazillian flavor.

Anyway, a good place to have some high-tier food in Blacksburg.
We only went for the milkshakes, which was delicious. Friendly service. Dine in available. Social distancing enforced.

The burgers at Freddy’s are so good and flavorful that me personally I feel they are better than Five Guys or shake shack. You can order as many patties as you want and compliment them with fries or even better the fried cheese curds. Their custard desserts are creamy and delicious and they also sell cakes and pies made with their recipes. The place has a vintage diner feel which is very cool. Definitely a great place to take the family.
Pretty good burgers, unique style. Love their Freddy's sauce. Good for sit down style with group or family.

Easily my favorite burger place in the area. The staff is always friendly and the wait is rarely longer than a few minutes.

The food is amazing, though I can only vouch for the steakburger, with some of the best fries at any fast food place I've ever been. The custard is, in it's many variations, definitely worth saving space for and the fact that you can pay for it up front and have it served after your meal is a nice little touch.

Every time I'm back in the area this place is on my must-go list and I suggest you add it to yours.
Best burgers and custard in the area! Staff are friendly as well and the food never disappoints :) I've even met Freddy himself when this place first opened and he is the sweetest and most humble man

Officially my favorite coffee place now. We got the frozen caramel coffee smoothie. Yum! Banana chocolate chip muffins were super good. Real bananas and moist.

Got bunny butt cupcakes for a Easter surprise for my daughter.

Got a birthday cake for my daughter. Absolutely amazing looking and tasted just as good. 1000% recommend all the backed good here!

Five stars!!! Great service. Great ice cream. Great drive through. The portions are large. The waffle cone soft serve was like having lunch. Their Resees sundae was luscious and perfectly crafted!! A must go spot on Chincoteague.

Great soft serve ice cream! I have been coming here for years. A Chincoteague must stop! Shown in the pics are an Oreo Cookie Sundae and a Berry Sundae. Both were outstanding. My favorite is the chocolate-vanilla twist dipped cone. Prices are reasonable. There is usually a line but worth the wait!
Nice place. Great prices. I will be back. Yum Soft Serve Ice Cream!!
Great ice cream. Many many choices and reasonable prices. They ONLY take cash so be ready.

Desiree and her team make some of the most delicious wedding "kupkakes" I've ever had the privilege of eating at weddings. As a wedding photographer/videographer, any chance I get to work with her at a wedding, I truly look forward to it. Of all the 500+ weddings I've covered in my career, the Kupkakery is hands down the best at flavors, the moistness and amazing cupcakes.
If you do anything for your wedding day, hire them for your wedding, TRUST me you will not be disappointed at all!
Made my daughters dedication cake and it exceeded our expectations of taste and presentation
The best "kupkakes" I've ever had!
Great place and awesome staff.  Made excellent cupcakes for my kids birthday!
WOW! Great cupcakes. My wife and I loved them. The staff here were very respectful addressing me as "sir". And they addressed my wife as "mam'm". Kupkakery Bakery is 5 stars all across the board!

First time dining here and food and service was great. I had the Mississippi Peace Maker with collards and mac n cheese. One complaint the mac n cheese was fair at best. Dry and perhaps sitting. Complimentary corn bread was good. The star of this show was the BBQ shrimp app I split with my brother. They offer a entree portion that I will be getting next time. Lot of beers on tap but I had water. Will return!

Great BBQ restaurant, close to my dad's house. Went there to meet a high school friend for dinner. Great expansive menu. Several great choices to choose from. Our server Maddie was awesome. She explained the menu to me and when I made my choice she said it was one of her favorites on the menu. She also was very attentative and refilled my drink without me even asking for a refill which was awesome.  I will be back here for sure. Awesome customer service from Maddie.
Took my mom out to a birthday dinner! Always enjoy a good brisket, steak and great service! Friendly servers, open space and nice environment.

County Grill had been a staple of my family dining for several decades. Just about everyone loves their complementary cornbread muffins and the house-made honey butter. We love the brisket and wings. The house made pickles include red onion giving them a unique flavor. The brisket is tender, but doesn't have a distinctive bark like others I've had. The beer selections are always on point. I went with the Alewerks Bourbon Barrel Porter. It paired well with my brisket platter dinner. My wife had their bacon wrapped buffalo shrimp appetizer and a Caesar salad as her meal. Unfortunately her shrimp made it out 10 minutes after everyone else at the table receive their entrees. The venue has expanded in the recent past, so it can cater to parties of up to a hundred people. The bar is typically packed out on Friday and Saturday nights; just be aware the regulars can be territorial.

Decided to have Sunday lunch here. Had not visited in a while, but will be back soon. Good customer service, and the food was delicious. They also have a large selection of craft beers. If you're looking for a good BBQ experience then give this place a try.

You may not want to stop here when driving on 95. Took forever to get a table and there where three of use waiting for a table. The staff played in the back. The waitress was very nice and was the only working. When I sat down two people where finishing their meals. I was there for over 40 min and no one clean their table. There eaten food just sat there.
I could nothing but cursing coming from the kitchen.  Joking , playing and loud.
My food came out and was ok . Meat cook  the way I like it. Cut of meat was better then expected. Shrimp was a no go.
Over products are ok. Staff is killing the place. Need a manager to clean it up.
Excellent I love this place very good food
Had a nice dinner while traveling for work. Half slab of ribs with side of corn and broccoli. Staff was nice.
We love this place. Every time good food, nice deals and great service.
Chicken wings were not good but veggies were ok, and biscuits were good.
